text:
The appointment management service was poor. I called to make an appointment the first day, but the specialist didn't show up or inform me. When I arrived close to my appointment time, they called to say the doctor wasn't available and to come another day. Then the next day, I made an appointment at 2:00 PM and waited an hour, but still couldn't see the doctor. I had to wait in line, even though I already had an appointment. I asked the staff, but they couldn't tell me what time I would see the doctor. I had to keep waiting...
Very poor service for this place. I already made an appointment, but still had to wait more than an hour.
When I asked the staff, they couldn't give me an answer about how long I would need to wait to see the dentist (but I already have an appointment and understand the wait, but not more than 1 or 2 hours). So I'm not impressed with this place and decided to move to another clinic where I can see a dentist at an appointment time.
